title: Provider
description: A place scans come from (museum, archive, library, community site). Stored as an array in library/providers.json.

rights_default.description: authorized = publisher-blessed and re-hostable; community-scan = grey area, host with takedown policy; link-only = never re-host, only link out

adapter.description: Name of the download/ingest script that speaks this provider's site or API

api.description: Machine-readable endpoint if any (e.g. IA advancedsearch / metadata API)

credit.description: Attribution line to show on issue pages
